sections.heading: Photo Booth City: Commercial Terms & Liability Shield

blocks.text: Professional Operator Acknowledgment

By purchasing equipment from photoboothcity.com, the Buyer acknowledges they are a Professional Operator. The Buyer represents that they possess the necessary technical knowledge to safely assemble, ballast (weight), and operate mechanical event equipment, including 360-degree rotating platforms and open-air kiosks.
Assumption of Risk (The "360 Clause")
The Buyer acknowledges that the 360 Platform contains motorized, rotating mechanical parts.
Clearance Zone: The Buyer agrees to maintain a minimum "Safety Clearance Zone" of at least 6 feet around the rotating arm at all times.
Supervision: The equipment must never be left unattended while powered on.
Guest Safety: The Buyer assumes all responsibility for guest injuries resulting from trips, falls, or impact with the rotating arm.
Indemnification & Hold Harmless

To the fullest extent permitted by law, the Buyer agrees to indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Photo Booth City (and its officers, employees, and affiliates) from any and all claims, damages, or lawsuits (including attorney fees) arising from:
The setup, operation, or teardown of the equipment at any event.
Any injuries to third parties (guests, clients, or staff) involving the equipment.
Any modifications made to the equipment by the Buyer after delivery.
Shipping Inspection & Mechanical Integrity
Since Photo Booth City ships via Freight and UPS Ground, the Buyer is responsible for a "Safety Integrity Check" upon arrival.
Reporting Period: Any structural damage (cracked welds, bent arms, loose motor mounts) must be reported to Photo Booth City within 48 hours of delivery.

Waiver: Use of the equipment after delivery constitutes the Buyer’s agreement that the unit is mechanically sound and safe for public use. Photo Booth City is not liable for injuries caused by equipment that was damaged during transit but put into service anyway.
Mandatory Insurance Representation

The Buyer warrants that they maintain Commercial General Liability Insurance with limits appropriate for the event industry. The Buyer acknowledges that Photo Booth City’s pricing does not include liability insurance for the Buyer’s business operations.
